industry: Building Construction Contractors and Operative Builders

building_market_mix.label: Building-market mix
building_market_mix.value: Residential homebuilding for homebuyers, primarily single-family homes, plus townhomes and condominiums

project_building_type.label: Project / building type
project_building_type.value: Homes sold and built under Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes brands across metropolitan areas in sixteen states

self_perform_subcontract_scope.label: Self-perform / subcontract scope
self_perform_subcontract_scope.value: Own Building Products plants make structural components delivered to job sites; on-site construction work largely subcontracted

builder_contractor_role.label: Builder / contractor role
builder_contractor_role.value: Operative homebuilder selling and constructing homes, with in-house mortgage banking and settlement services for buyers

land_inventory_exposure_operative_builde.label: Land / inventory exposure [operative builders]
land_inventory_exposure_operative_builde.value: Asset-light: controls finished lots mainly through options with developers rather than owning raw land; builds largely to buyer order
